response.justification: Highly accomplished software engineer with 20+ years of experience and strong expertise in high-performance distributed systems and backend architecture. However, the role explicitly requires deep current C++ expertise and industrial automation domain knowledge—neither demonstrated here. The candidate's recent career (web/startup/AI infrastructure) diverges significantly from manufacturing machinery contexts. Would represent substantial onboarding risk despite strong engineering fundamentals.
strengths: Exceeds experience requirement with 20+ years of software development across complex distributed systems and high-performance backends
Demonstrated ability to optimize low-latency concurrent systems (Dunnhumby handling millions of requests/sec, asynchronous I/O, fibers) and rapidly learn multiple programming languages
Strong track record of leadership, mentoring, software craftsmanship, and commitment to testing practices across open-source and commercial projects
concerns: Critical gap: No C++ experience in past 7+ years; only clear C++ role was 2014-2015 at National Instruments, making fit for explicit 'C++ Developer' core requirement problematic
Zero demonstrated experience in industrial automation, manufacturing machinery, embedded systems, IoT, or industrial protocols (Modbus TCP/IP, IEC 61850, OPC UA, etc.)
No evidence of secure development lifecycle (SDL), IEC 62443 cybersecurity standards, or industrial control system security—all explicitly listed as core competencies
